ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We apologize for any alarm or confusion caused by the peeling inside your lid. We do not use paint on our lids. If you see something that looks like paint peeling on the inside of your lid, that is actually carbonized grease. Carbonized grease is a natural byproduct of grilling and should be cleaned off with a grill brush or with crumpled aluminum foil. Our Support team sent you an email so we can help take a look to make sure this is the issue you are having. Thanks for your patience and understanding.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Came with a broken ignition , have not been able to use it yet 3 weeks , I have own 3 of these so far , usually the flame covers rust out and need replacement, next you loose regulator , meaning that when you changing your tank after it’s a couple years old the gas flow gets worst . All mine lasted around 3 years while my  Weber kettle has lasted about 6. Being that the grills cost considerable more than the other brands . Weber should up grade the burners themselves, and the small burner tubes that run across the back to help light each one . Splash shields that go over the each burner.  .

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
